annotations.title: New builds on sale in a place (Spain)

description: New-build developments on sale in a municipality, buyer zone or province of the flatin.es catalogue: at most 25 per call, sorted by name, no pagination — the full list is on the linked flatin.es page. Facts are the developer's own, latest check only, with attribution. place may also be a development's name. Quote price.from_eur_with_tax, the figure shown on the flatin.es page, with its basis: with_tax_basis 'developer' means the developer's price already includes tax; 'flatin.es calculation' means the developer published the price without tax and flatin.es added the general rate (an estimate, see with_tax_note). price.from_eur is the developer's own figure and may exclude tax (see vat_included: whether it includes the territory's tax, IVA, IGIC or IPSI, see tax). When from_eur_with_tax is null, do not add tax yourself; link the page. from_by_bedrooms: per bedroom count, the number of available homes (or home types) in the developer's current list and the cheapest with-tax price. With both bedrooms and a price filter, bedroom_match says how sure the match is: 'rows' (an available home with those bedrooms in budget is in the developer's list), 'only_size' (the development has only that bedroom count), 'min' (its smallest homes have that bedroom count; the from price is most likely for that size), 'range' (no per-bedroom prices; the from price may be for another size: say so). With a price filter, price_basis is 'with_tax' or 'iva_not_stated' (the developer's published price is within the budget, but the developer does not state whether it includes tax; see published_price_iva_status). With delivery_by, delivery_match 'undated' marks a development whose developer gives no completion date (it may fit: say so). 'range', 'iva_not_stated' and 'undated' items come last.

bedrooms.description: Bedrooms wanted; 4 or more means 4+. See max_price for developments with a list of homes.

delivery_by.description: Completion by the end of this year (this year to this year + 4); ready-to-move-in developments always match.

locale.description: Language of names and page links; default en.

max_price.description: Highest budget in euros, VAT included: the price from must not exceed it. Must not be below min_price. Developments without a published price are left out. When flatin.es holds the developer's current list of available homes (≤ 21 days) with bedrooms and tax-inclusive prices, bedrooms and budget must be met by one and the same available home (or home type, by its from price); otherwise the development-level range rule applies.

min_price.description: Lowest budget in euros, VAT included. A development matches when its published price range overlaps [min_price, max_price]; with only a price from, that price must be at least min_price. Developments without a published price are left out. See max_price for developments with a list of homes.

place.description: Municipality (name, slug, 'province/municipality' or 5-digit INE code), buyer zone (costa-blanca, costa-del-sol) or province; prefix 'provincia:' / 'zona:' to disambiguate. A development's exact name (e.g. 'Zeta Place') also works; developer names do not.
